old_caption: The video captures a close-up scene of a stainless steel pot on a stovetop, filled with vigorously boiling water. Steam rises from the surface, indicating the high temperature. The pot is positioned centrally in the frame, with its handle visible on the left side. A metal spoon holds a single brown egg suspended above the boiling water. The egg is lowered into the pot, causing ripples on the surface. The steam continues to rise, emphasizing the heat. The spoon remains in the frame, holding the egg as it is lowered and then partially submerged. The egg remains partially above the water surface in the final frames. The background remains consistent throughout, focusing solely on the pot and the cooking process. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, and the camera maintains a steady position, capturing the detailed action of the egg being boiled.

The pot is positioned centrally in the frame, with its handle visible on the left side. As the video progresses, a hand enters the frame from the left, holding a metal spoon. The spoon is used to carefully place a single brown egg into the boiling water. The egg is gently lowered into the pot, causing ripples on the surface of the water. The steam continues to rise, emphasizing the heat. After the egg is fully submerged, the spoon is removed from the frame, leaving the egg to cook in the boiling water. The background remains consistent throughout, focusing solely on the pot and the cooking process. There are no other objects or characters present in the video, and the camera maintains a steady position, capturing the detailed action of the egg being boiled.
caption: The video captures a close-up view of a stainless-steel pot filled with boiling water on a dark stovetop, with steam rising. A long-handled metal spoon enters from the left edge, carrying a single brown egg above the pot rim. The spoon and egg lower together toward the churning water while the pot remains fixed. As they descend, the spoon bowl moves into the pot and the egg remains cradled in it. The lower part of the egg reaches the water line and touches the moving surface. Bubbles and ripples disturb the contact area, while steam partially veils the upper background. The spoon continues supporting the egg at the surface, keeping the upper shell visible. The visible handle shifts downward as the bowl enters the pot, but the egg remains held. The boiling water stays active, and the egg stays partly at the water surface in the spoon. The process shows careful lowering toward the pot, without revealing the hand controlling the spoon.
